note: Iowa DNR state park on 218-acre Prairie Rose Lake, with East and West campgrounds about 700 m apart around an arm of the lake. East's outer row looks across its loop road and an open lawn to the water. West is farther from the shore. --Claude
summary: Hookups, showers, dump and base fees confirmed (non-electric base holds on sites 073/075/079). Count 77->81 RV sites; season Apr-Oct -> year round with water off in winter; booking until 10 pm on arrival and never first-come; lakeview holds.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview holds. East map and imagery agree: every East site (7-14, 24-38 included) is on the inland side of the loop road, with about 40 m of open mown lawn and scattered trees from road to shore (scaled from imagery). A loop road blocks on-water. West is further from the water.

IOWA ROW: this booking page states the cutoff outright ('until 10:00 pm CST the day of arrival') and '100 percent reservable', which is what the state:IA row's note says nobody had established. It's the campground's own page, so I wrote reserve_until and fcfs:never here; AWH's reported 48-hour rule remains in that row's note and the row is untouched. I checked this one park only.
